offers_products.reason: Sells staffing and recruiting work; no goods or software among its main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Temporary, direct-hire, contract staffing and executive search delivered through franchised offices.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are businesses hiring staff; job seekers are placed, not the buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Businesses in construction, light industrial, healthcare, finance and manufacturing buy its staffing solutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Temporary staffing is repeat, ongoing client business, plus franchise royalties; direct-hire placements are one-off.

cyclical_demand.reason: Clients cut temporary and permanent hiring quickly in downturns; staffing is hiring-driven.

big_ticket.reason: Staffing is billed in frequent, small weekly invoices for temporary workers.

people_delivered.reason: What clients pay for is people: temporary workers and recruiters' time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Local franchise offices serve mostly small and mid-sized businesses in trades and light industrial.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light franchisor; franchisees run offices, with no plants or fleets.

notes: Customer size is inferred from the franchise model, not stated on the site.
